body:
## What it does

A night shift for a single product: the owner queues up what they want built, and the work happens while nobody is watching. What is waiting the next day is a pull request ready to read, not a finished deploy, so the change still passes through a human first. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @joshkim shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
